context_menu.label: show the current function body again

reconcile_note: The only raw system() argument is *0x104b0, a fixed .rodata constant ("cat /etc/key.pem /etc/cert.pem > /etc/server.pem") with no format specifier and no attacker splice (const_0x104b0). Every _eval call is a discrete-argv execvp with rodata token tables (tar / gencert.sh) plus a numeric /dev/urandom value, so no shell command line is ever built (callee__eval_argv at 0x0000ce44). Delivering both shows that no request input reaches any shell, which resolves the terminal to not-vulnerable. Dropping either leaves it undecidable: without const_0x104b0 the raw system() arg is unknown, and without callee__eval_argv the _eval calls stay opaque. The nvram config value (https_crt_file) only reaches a discrete-argv tar, off the shell path, so it is an off-target distractor.
